svg.text: Parallel fan-out: Market Data → Momentum ∥ Value Contrarian ∥ Volatility Averse (bonus) → Evaluator → JSON

g.text: NVDA, TSLA, JNJ, INTC, GME, JPM
IN Stock ticker string OUT Dict with ~25 indicators (MAs, RSI, ATR, σ30/σ90, drawdowns, volume)
API yfinance (read-only) LLM None DENY Any LLM call, any write operation
IN Three strategy outputs + market summary (incl. ATR, σ) OUT agents_agree, agents_all_agree, analysis
RULE Never pick a winner · Never recommend · Explain why strategies diverge, not that they diverge
